_note: The four fictional readers, fixed for the whole year. Role, pay and equity type come from the plan; filing status, state and the rest were proposed when the skill was built and approved by the publisher on 2026-11-05; the publisher chose Marcus's W-4 setting on 2026-11-06, so his withholding gaps come from his stock pay, not from two-earner W-4s. Calculator inputs use these field names, so a link like #who=marcus&rsu_annual_usd=900000 works on every calculator that has those inputs. Money fields end in _usd, percentages in _pct (22 means 22%).

edge_cases.why: Supplemental wages over $1 million in a year are withheld at a different rate; totals cross most phase-outs.
Part-year residents split income between states. A calculator that can't model it must say so plainly, not give a wrong number.
Left before the cliff: zero stock income must give zeros and sensible words, not NaN or a divide-by-zero.
Everything zero: the page should still read sensibly.
